title: Can Can Bunny Extra
native_title: きゃんきゃんバニー エクストラ
overview:
A lighthearted romance adventure in the Can Can Bunny series. The green-haired goddess Swatty returns with her love magic to help the hero, Kawamura Kouhei, meet women and find his true love. Head around town to places like a hospital, a church and a museum, get to know a varied cast of women, and choose your words and actions to win their hearts.

- Supports the Shuttle Mouse and the Sega Multi Controller
